args_schema.description: Config accepted by both trigger types, and the args of both observable functions (`args_format`).

metadata.description: Equality match against the record's `session_metadata` (every key given here must equal the stored value — subset match).

session_id.description: Only deliver events for this session.

args_schema.title: BindingConfig

description: Fires when a pending approval leaves the inbox (outcome: allow | deny | timeout | aborted), exactly once per record. Observe it with args { session_id?, metadata? } (the approval::pending-resolved binding config); every matching observer receives the PendingResolvedEvent. Only the approval-gate worker fires it: invoking it directly is refused.

event_schema.description: Payload of `approval::pending-resolved` — a pending call left the inbox. Emitted exactly once per record (gated on the record delete).
event_schema.title: PendingResolvedEvent
